# llms.txt — Agent Enhancement Playbook

> Machine-readable index for AI agents. Human entry point: README.md

## What this is

A playbook for enhancing production AI agents: evidence-graded findings (harness > model variance), capability combos, anti-patterns, a 12-dimension production ledger with real failure records, and a prioritized action checklist. Chinese primary language.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, 10 core findings, methodology, credibility grading
- [Agent Enhancement Final](docs/agent-enhancement-final.md): full synthesis — 10 findings, 4-layer framework, combos C1-C8, anti-patterns K1-K9, 12-dim ledger, P0-P2 checklist
- [12-Dim Production Ledger](docs/12-dim-production-ledger.md): per-dimension practices and real failure records from one production agent (N=1, 2026-08~11)
- [Repo Map](docs/repo-map.md): 14-dimension curated GitHub repo map (star/activity snapshot 2026-09-03)
- [Cheat Sheet](docs/cheatsheet.md): quick-reference combos, anti-patterns, action checklist
- [Failure Cases](docs/failure-cases.md): 9 real silent-failure cases (phenomenon/misjudgment/root cause/fix/lesson)
- [Canary Questions Template](templates/canary-questions.md): evaluation anti-cheating template (full score = evidence of cheating)
- [Memory Eviction Reference](templates/memory_eviction.py): executable 4-factor eviction scoring script
- [Success Criteria Template](templates/success-criteria.md): falsifiability template for long-term investments
- [References](docs/references.md): cited-sources registry — 19 arXiv papers + 5 official blogs with links, evidence grades, and unresolved-source flags
- [Cheat Sheet Skill](skills/agent-enhancement-cheatsheet/SKILL.md): skills.sh-packaged quick reference loadable by agents
- [Full Text](llms-full.txt): deterministic full-repo aggregation (build artifact via scripts/build-llms-full.py; do not hand-edit)
- [Build Script](scripts/build-llms-full.py): regenerates llms-full.txt (--check detects drift)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): version history

## Evidence grading legend

- 🟢 verified against primary source by the author
- 🔵 extracted from full text by research subagents (key numbers spot-checked)
- 🟡 second-hand citation

## Citing rules

Keep the evidence grade with any number you quote. Preprint numbers (arXiv 2605.23950 HV/MV=7.80x etc.) are non-peer-reviewed and declared non-universal by their authors. Star counts are 2026-09-03 snapshots and proxy popularity, not quality. Invalidation signals are listed in AGENTS.md.
